task: Write an article for your school magazine about the benefits of reading. Give two reasons and one personal example.
studentDraft: Reading is an indispensable activity that everyone should engage in. It ameliorates your vocabulary and makes you more erudite. When you read, you can abscond from reality and enter a different world. For example, I recently read a book about World War II. The book was very interesting and I learned many things. Reading also helps you write better because you see how good writers construct sentences. I think reading is very important for students. It helps you in school and in life. You should read more books.
notes: Calibration fixture: sophisticated-inappropriate-vocabulary. Uses 'ameliorates' (wrong: improves vocabulary, not 'ameliorates'), 'erudite' (unnatural), 'abscond' (wrong: means to flee/escape law, not 'escape into imagination'). Awaiting human-marker review.
